# Every form

One line for each way a wikilink is written.

- plain: [[finishes]]
- by path: [[rooms/Note]]
- with its suffix: [[finishes.md]]
- with words: [[finishes|the chosen finishes]]
- a heading: [[kitchen-sink#Tables]]
- two headings: [[kitchen-sink#Lists#Nested]]
- a heading here: [[#Further down]]
- a block: [[finishes#^abc123]]
- one name, two folders: [[Note]]
- capitals: [[greenhouse]]
- an accent: [[Café]]
- a space: [[paint colours]]
- a picture: ![[handle.png]]
- a picture, narrow: ![[handle.png|40]]
- a note embedded: ![[finishes]]
- a pdf: [[report.pdf]]
- an outline: [[house.olai]]
- a row: [[house.olai#kitchen]]
- an outline by bare name: [[house]]
- nothing by that name: [[nowhere]]
- in code: `[[finishes]]`
- escaped: \[[finishes]]

| Where | Link |
| --- | --- |
| in a table | [[kitchen-sink\|the sink table]] |

## Further down

The heading the link above lands on.
